alex: Heads-up — compiling PRD checklist for generation API edge cases. Focus: streaming resume, truncation, token-limit behavior, retry semantics. Need acceptance criteria and dev notes by EOD Wed. @maria can you add customer ask prioritization? @dave runtime constraints?

maria: From CS + PMs: three customers hit inconsistent streaming resumes when token-limit cut off mid-response; they want a deterministic resume token and clear error codes. Proposed acceptance criteria:
- resume works when prefix/kv preserved
- explicit error codes for truncated/incomplete vs rate/overquota (e.g., 413_truncation, 429_rate)
- SDK + docs examples for resume flow
Prioritize P1 for Dedicated & Hosted, P2 for Private.

dave: Runtime notes / constraints:
- resume requires an opaque, stable continuation token (server-signed cursor)
- if truncation is due to model max-length (not user token-limit), return response with "truncated": true and metadata: consumed_tokens, model_seq_len, resume_cursor (if resumable)
- retry semantics: client retries allowed only if operation is idempotent (no DB side-effects) and server marks "retryable": true. For 5xx -> retryable=true; for 4xx -> false except specific transient 429 cases
- cost: server-side checkpoints increase memory/kv overhead, need config per-deployment (Dedicated can opt-in)

sophia: Model/ML edge cases to call out:
- quantized models may emit extra pad tokens, causing off-by-one resume mismatch; acceptance tests must assert content equivalence after resume for several quantized configs
- stop-sequence vs token-limit: if a stop-sequence is hit but we truncated mid-token, define canonical priority (stop-sequence wins only if fully observed)
- streaming backpressure/disconnect: allow resume only within a short window (suggest 30s by default), otherwise session invalidated

alex: Good points. Quick enumeration of test cases I'll include in PRD draft:
- resume success after short disconnect (client reconnects, provides resume token)
- resume failure when prompt mutated between attempts (must detect and reject)
- retry allowed after transient 5xx, rejected for deterministic 4xx
- truncation due to client token quota vs model max-length vs stop-sequence (different error metadata)
- streaming chunk loss and reassembly (out-of-order chunks)

maria: Metrics + launch criteria suggestions:
- metrics: resume_success_rate, resume_latency_p50/p95, truncation_rate_by_model, retries_by_code
- launch criteria: synthetic suite <1% resume failure, docs + SDK sample, migration guide for existing clients, rollout plan for Dedicated customers

dave: Implementation proposal (short):
- introduce header `X-Resume-Token` for client -> server on reconnect
- response fields: `resume_cursor` (opaque), `truncated`: boolean, `truncated_reason`: string, `retryable`: boolean
- add explicit error codes: `incomplete_generation` (with meta), `cannot_resume` (prompt mismatch / expired), `cannot_resume_after_tool_call`
- small RFC needed for fallback policy (model variant fallback when capacity constrained)

ci-bot: @alex RFC draft created: /docs/rfcs/1789504321-generation-resume.md (automated) :white_check_mark:

sophia: Edge-case: streaming + function-calls mid-stream — we need atomicity: if a tool/function is invoked based on partial tokens, resuming may cause duplicate tool calls. Proposal: forbid resume after any function/tool call and return `cannot_resume_after_tool_call` (409) with details. Also add test that simulates function call triggered on token boundary.

alex: Thanks all — I'll post the full PRD draft tomorrow morning with the enumerated test matrix, sample requests/responses, and acceptance criteria. Tagging @eng for dev estimates and @security for data retention implications. :rocket:

maria: One more ask from enterprise sales — expose resume_token TTL as config (per-customer) and audit logs for resume events. Add to PRD.

dave: Acknowledged. I'll sketch the perf/ops doc (memory + KV requirements) after we lock acceptance criteria.

alex: Perfect. Closing this thread for now — moving to PRD draft. Please add any last-minute edge cases as replies on the PRD doc itself. :eyes:
